title: bndy workboard
description: Single view of active bndy product, platform, ingestion, intelligence and growth work.
principles: Canonical BNDY APIs remain the write authority.
Capture is transport and durable intake, not the intelligence engine.
Enrichment is the strategic resolution and intelligence runtime.
BNDY Backline is the capability/product name; bndy-enrichment remains the single strategic Backline runtime rather than creating a parallel repository.
All new ingestion paths should converge on Capture + Enrichment rather than inventing another write path.
The target state is evidence -> claims -> projection -> canonical BNDY, not source -> direct database write.
BNDY Backline is the durable intelligence substrate: immutable evidence plus observations and atomised claims feed policy and projection; the graph is a derived view, not the authority.

repositories.role: Core public gig discovery PWA: map, gigs, artists, venues, festivals, favourites and public add flows.
Authoritative artists, venues, events, festivals, auth, curator policy, source inspection and edition-aware APIs.
Admin operations, curator policy management and traffic visibility.
Public brand, proposition, policy and architecture pages. The workboard lives here.
Public Dropzone UI for gig poster and text submission. Routes into Capture.
Durable intake transport for Android Send to bndy and public web submissions. Stores evidence and queue state.
Strategic Backline runtime for source acquisition, immutable evidence, observations, atomised claims, identity resolution, authority, projection, Capture processing and enrichment.
Thin agent-facing adapter around BNDY capabilities. Needs a current-role audit as Enrichment becomes the orchestration layer.
Older Signal -> interpretation -> claims implementation. Useful concepts should be absorbed then the runtime retired.
Previous public application. Do not use for new work.
Shared type definitions used by older/newer surfaces where applicable.
Shared UI package from the earlier application generation. Audit before expanding usage.

now.title: Safe entity enrichment worker
now.detail: SAFETY CORE, DAILY PLANNER, INDEXED DUE SET, BOUNDED PROVIDER SEAM AND REPRODUCIBLE QUALIFICATION GATE MERGED, NO CONCRETE PROVIDER OR SCHEDULE. The evidence-only processor caps each item to one entity, three searches, six fetches, one cheap model call, 12k/2k tokens, estimated cost 0.03 and 60 seconds. It parks identity confidence below 0.98, blocks unsafe citations/values, flags owner-managed and conflicting facts, stores immutable Observations/Claims and has zero canonical writes by construction. Dynamo atomically reserves item idempotency plus daily provider counters, capped at 20 entities and estimated cost 0.60. The planner prioritises resolved entities attached to upcoming gigs, carries exact supported quality gaps, defaults to five Artists and five Venues per day, and applies a 30-day attempt cooldown. Its due set uses an exact primary-key time-range query, examines at most 200 candidates and never scans. The inactive provider seam permits at most two identity-and-location searches and one cheap reasoning call, accepts only requested predicates and captured HTTPS citations, and records full evidence and usage. Qualification requires at least 20 reviewed cases including five Artists, five Venues, two ambiguous Artists and two ambiguous Venues. Any confident false match or unnecessary park fails, as do unsafe facts, budget breaches, mixed providers, duplicate cases, missing usage or less than 80 percent gap coverage on expected matches. No provider is qualified yet. Remaining: capture and adjudicate one real provider cohort, pass the command-line gate, conduct sampled live sanity review, then add disabled Lambda wiring.

lanes.title: Venue listing workers
lanes.objective: Keep high-value venue calendars fresh by revisiting known reliable venue websites on a predictable cadence.

done.title: Capability fits the Source Registry model
done.detail: Known venue websites are sources. Their pages can be scheduled, observed, interpreted into event claims and deduped through the normal projection path.

now.title: Define the watched-venue registry
now.detail: Identify venues with reliable, actively maintained listings and store source URL, parsing/acquisition strategy, cadence and last successful scan.

next.title: Weekly venue worker schedule
next.detail: Run one source job per watched venue weekly, with retry/backoff and a faster cadence only where evidence justifies it.

next.title: Delta new listings into Claims
next.detail: Only new/changed gigs become claims. Existing gigs dedupe normally; removed listings are not treated as cancellations unless source semantics are explicit.

next.title: Venue freshness dashboard
next.detail: Show last checked, last changed, failures and new gigs found in Godmode so reliable sources can be expanded safely.
